Connected planning

Retirement forecasts with your assistant

Review your assumptions together, then run a forecast or compare two plans.

Connect Retirement Forecast

In ChatGPT or Codex, open Plugins → Personal → Created by you, choose Retirement Forecast - Monte Carlo Simulator, then Install or Connect. Follow the Sites sign-in prompt. Access through this private plugin depends on its availability to your account; a public directory listing has not been approved.

Hosted forecasts are available to connected accounts.

Use the methodology tool to review model assumptions before running a forecast. A connection gives your assistant tools to calculate and explain forecasts; it does not automatically load your saved browser plans.

Try a prompt

  • “Help me create a retirement forecast. Ask for the assumptions you need and review them with me before running it.”
  • “Use the website’s example assumptions for projections I answer ‘unknown’ to. Show me those values before running.”
  • “Compare retiring at 65 with retiring at 67, keeping my other assumptions the same.”
  • “Explain how this model handles healthcare, taxes and life expectancy.”

If you do not know projected returns, volatility, inflation, healthcare or long-term-care costs, or your future stock allocation, the assistant can offer the same illustrative assumptions as the browser planner. It should show those defaults for your review before calculating, then identify which ones were used in the result. Entered values take priority. Healthcare costs are examples, not insurance quotes or personal care estimates.

The assistant still needs your balances, income, ordinary spending, dates and account histories; it should ask for missing personal figures. You can export a plan from the browser and share it with your assistant after reviewing the file.

Access and limits

Connected Free accounts can run up to 100 paths per scenario and 20 calculation calls per UTC hour. Pro includes up to 1,000 paths and 60 calls per hour; owner access is complimentary. Each comparison runs two scenarios and counts as one call. One calculation may be active per account.

A 100-path run is a preview of sample outcomes, too small to estimate retirement readiness. Hosted calculations use a 20-second computation budget; unusually complex plans may need an explicitly smaller run. Pro browser forecasts still support up to 10,000 paths. Manage subscriptions and link sign-ins through Plans & billing.

What you share

Assistant forecasts send the assumptions you approve to this hosted service for temporary calculation and return results to your assistant. The application does not save those inputs or results in its database, caches, URLs or diagnostic logs. Your assistant and hosting providers follow their own data policies.

The service keeps pseudonymous usage counters for 48 hours and aggregate daily tool outcomes and duration ranges. Expired counters are removed when the service next receives calculation activity. Read the privacy notice before sharing a personal plan. Browser-only forecasts continue to run locally.

Understand the result

These are hypothetical U.S. retirement scenarios for educational use. They are not predictions, guarantees or individualized financial, tax or investment advice. Shared random paths make comparisons more consistent; larger samples cannot correct inaccurate assumptions. Review the model scope and limitations.

Help connecting

If the plugin is unavailable, use the browser planner or contact support. The hosted endpoint for compatible clients is https://retirement-readiness-lab-web.rtsoliday123.chatgpt.site/mcp; Sites manages its authentication.
